name: Shadowfall
description:
*You vanish. They fall. You reappear.*

**Heroic Ability** — Area, Melee, Weapon — Main action

**Cost:** 9 Insight

**Distance:** 10 x 1 line within 1   **Target:** Each enemy in the area

**Power Roll + Agility:**

- **≤11:** 10 damage
- **12-16:** 14 damage
- **17+:** 20 damage

**Effect:** You disappear before making the power roll. After the power roll is resolved, you appear in the first unoccupied space at the far end of the line.
